decisive_items: well-defined, 19-mm mass in the left parietal bone near the squamosal suture, centred in the diploic space, with sparse but preserved trabeculae and a slight bony bulge
The preserved trabecular architecture and presence of hyperintense foci on T1-weighted images suggesting bone marrow fat are characteristic of hemangioma.
response.rationale: R2 is the strongest candidate due to the specific location in the diploic space and the characteristic imaging features of hemangioma, including preserved trabeculae and hyperintense foci on T1-weighted images. R5, although a possible diagnosis, lacks specific features that distinguish osteoma from other benign bone tumors.

rejected.why: Lack of specific imaging features characteristic of lipoma, and the presence of hyperintense foci on T1 images is more suggestive of hemangioma.
Although C1 provides more specific anatomical information, it is an append-only completion of R2 and does not provide a distinct diagnosis.
